entities.name: Italy in World War I

entities.summary: Italy's entry into WWI on the Allied side (Treaty of London), the horrific Isonzo battles, the catastrophic defeat at Caporetto (1917), the recovery at Vittorio Veneto, and the 'mutilated victory' at the Paris Peace Conference.
